system.title: Sheriff

backgrounds.name: Retainers
backgrounds.notes: Five disgraced ex-cops, superbly Conditioned and utterly loyal

system.biography:
Background

Thomas S. Ewell was a Confederate cavalry officer and bank-robbing outlaw during the American Civil War who fled to Canada afterward. There he was Embraced by Alexis Blanc, the self-styled @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} "prince" of Ottawa, and took the name Balthazar. Bored and broke, he journeyed to Chicago in the 1870s with Alexis and her Blood-Bound thrall Marc Levesque to back Modius, the socialist Prince of Gary, in his war against Prince Lodin. When the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} elder Hinds offered him wealth and free rein over vessels, Balthazar betrayed Modius and Alexis, personally staking his own sire and burning her haven with her still inside. Lodin rewarded him well, and over the following century Balthazar became Lodin's primary enforcer, tasked with suppressing the anarchs — a role that earned him the mocking nickname "the Sheriff," which he has since claimed with pride. With Lodin's death, Balthazar has begun eyeing the princeship himself, campaigning on a platform of crushing the anarchs, though the primogen see him as too divisive to actually rule.

Roleplaying Hints

Pushy, arrogant, and physically imposing — Balthazar takes up space and dares people to object. He affects an exaggerated cowboy persona (Stetson, boots, tobacco) as a defiant answer to the insults other @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} throw at him, but cleans up well when trying to impress the primogen. He craves the respect he knows he'll never fully have from his own clan, who despise him as a traitor.

Disciplines (as printed, dot-rating, converted to owned Discipline Items on this Actor): Auspex 1, Celerity 2, Dominate 5, Fortitude 3, Potence 3, Presence 2.
system.notes: Sire: Alexis Blanc (destroyed by Balthazar himself). Hated by the wider @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} clan as a turncoat. Frequently found holding court at the Rack. His five ex-cop Retainers are Conditioned and will do nearly anything he orders.

vtmlarp.source: Chicago by Night, 2nd Edition, Chapter Four: The Kindred
